operations.description: Method will retrieve an article based on given CORE ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] article by core id [PATH] articles [PARAMS] citations core duplicate faithful fulltext id metadata similar urls [SCHEMA] article citation document journal language raw record repository response similar xml

operations.description: Method will retrieve an article based on given CORE ID.
operations.summary: Get fulltext PDF by CORE ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] article pdf by core id [PATH] articles download pdf [PARAMS] core id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Method accepts a single CORE ID and returns a list of all historical versions of the article, which are stored in CORE database. The results are ordered from the newest one to the oldest one.
operations.summary: Get article history by CORE ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] article history by core id [PATH] articles history [PARAMS] core id page size [SCHEMA] article history raw record response xml

operations.description: Searches through all articles and returns a JSON array with search results. Method searches through all article fields.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] search articles [PATH] articles search [PARAMS] citations duplicate faithful fulltext metadata page query similar size urls [SCHEMA] article citation document journal language raw record repository response search similar xml

operations.description: Returns a journal with given ISSN identifier.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] journal by issn [PATH] journals [PARAMS] issn [SCHEMA] journal response

operations.description: Searches through all journals and returns a JSON array of search results. Method searches through all journal fields (title, identifiers, subjects, language, rights and publisher).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] journals search [PARAMS] page query size [SCHEMA] journal response search

operations.description: Method will retrieve a repository based on given CORE repository ID.
operations.summary: Get repository by CORE repository ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] repository by id [PATH] repositories [PARAMS] cumulative deposit history id repository stats [SCHEMA] location repository response stats

operations.description: Searches through all repositories and returns a JSON array with search results. Method searches through all repository fields.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] repositories search [PARAMS] cumulative deposit history page query size stats [SCHEMA] location repository response search stats

operations.description: Searches through all resources and returns a JSON array with search results. Method searches through all resources and all fields. The results are ordered by relevance score and contain type of the relevant resource and its ID. The metadata of each resource need to be obtained through an appropriate method.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] search [PARAMS] page query size [SCHEMA] all resource response search

operations.description: Method accepts values for several parameters and retrieves a JSON array of articles which have near duplicate content matching the input parameters' values. The response array contains ids of the near duplicate articles along with their relevance scores.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] near duplicate articles [PATH] articles dedup [PARAMS] description doi fulltext id identifier repository title year [SCHEMA] article dedup response

operations.description: Method accepts a JSON array of CORE IDs and retrieves a list of articles. The response array is ordered based on the order of the IDs in the request array.
operations.summary: Batch operation for retrieving articles by CORE ID
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] article by core id batch [PATH] articles [PARAMS] citations duplicate faithful fulltext metadata similar urls [SCHEMA] article citation document journal language raw record repository response similar xml

operations.description: Method accepts a JSON array of search queries and parameters. It then searches through all articles and returns a JSON array of search results for each of the queries. Method searches through all article fields (title, authors, subjects, identifiers, etc.).
operations.summary: Batch operation for search through articles
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] search articles batch [PATH] articles search [PARAMS] citations duplicate faithful fulltext metadata similar urls [SCHEMA] array article document language raw record repository request response search xml

operations.description: Method accepts a text and retrieves a JSON array of articles which are similar to the given text. The response array is ordered based on similarity score, starting from the most similar.
operations.summary: Get articles by similarity to a text
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] similar articles [PATH] articles similar [PARAMS] citations duplicate faithful fulltext limit metadata similar urls [SCHEMA] article citation document journal language raw record repository request response similar xml

operations.description: Method accepts a JSON array of ISSNs and retrieves a list of journals.
operations.summary: Batch operation for retrieving journals by ISSN
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] journal by issn batch [PATH] journals [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] journal response

operations.description: Method accepts a JSON array of search queries and parameters. It then searches through all journals and returns a JSON array of search results for each of the queries. Method searches through all journal fields (title, identifiers, subjects, language, rights and publisher).
operations.summary: Batch operation for search through journals
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] journals search [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] journal request response search

operations.description: Method accepts a JSON array of CORE repository IDs and retrieves a list of repositories. The response array is ordered based on the order of the IDs in the request array. The maximum number of IDs in request is 100.
operations.summary: Batch operation for retrieving repositories by CORE repository ID
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] repository by id batch [PATH] repositories [PARAMS] cumulative deposit history stats [SCHEMA] location repository response stats

operations.description: Method accepts a JSON array of search queries and parameters. It then searches through all repositories and returns a JSON array of search results for each of the queries. Method searches through all repository fields.
operations.summary: Batch operation for searching through repositories
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] repositories search [PARAMS] cumulative deposit history stats [SCHEMA] array location repository request response search stats

operations.description: Method accepts a JSON array of search queries. It searches through all resources and returns a JSON array with search results for each of the queries. Method searches through all resources and all fields. The results are ordered by relevance score and contain type of the relevant resource and its ID. Furthermore, the responses are oredered based on the order of the request items. The metadata of each resource need to be obtained through an appropriate method.
operations.summary: Batch operation for search through all resources
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] search [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] all request resource response search
